mentions.name: YouTube Shorts Generator
mentions.description: An open-source tool that converts long YouTube videos into Shorts automatically. It runs a fully local parallel pipeline with no APIs or subscriptions: Whisper handles transcription, LLaVA analyzes frames to find interesting moments, and Mistral picks clips and writes captions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
YouTube Shorts Generator
Converts long YouTube videos into Shorts automatically. Whisper handles transcription, LLaVA analyzes frames to find interesting moments, Mistral picks clips and writes captions. Everything runs locally in a parallel pipeline. No APIs, no subscriptions.
